objective: Finish verifying UC-04 (openspec/changes/uc-04-confirm-current-question/) live and reduce agent result rejections, without loosening any Focus rule.
acceptance_criteria: Live sequence (task 4.1): a scripted live run with only Pablo audible covers a multipart question into Live, Confirm, reflection, an answer with a restatement, the ANSWER phase after Confirm, a new question in Live while Focus holds, a second Confirm and Clear live, recording displayed wording, identities and outcomes.

Failure cases (task 4.2): stale and retired confirmations, delayed acknowledgements, network loss, late model output and Stop/restart are exercised through browser plus service, with render, commit and transcript times.

Rejections: the causes of rejected agent results are measured from the text-free audit reasons, and a later live run rejects a smaller share than run 3 (5 of 11) without changing the rule that only Confirm writes Focus.
Feedback: the Confirmed... message clears once the answer starts, if Pablo confirms that behavior.
Tests: node --test poc/poc.test.mjs and poc/browser-protocol.mjs pass, and the benchmark transcript and timestamps in eval-data/ stay unchanged.
